summary: Enclosed timber lookout on Pacheco Peak, Santa Clara County, built 1935; a 1988 state filing describes taking it apart and moving it. The record's 1980 removal date is wrong.

facts.design: Forest Service Region 5 plan BC-301 cabin atop an enclosed timber tower
facts.status_note: Taken down in the late 1980s; a 1988 state filing describes it being moved.
facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection - Santa Clara Unit (CAL FIRE - SCU)

events.note: Register: built 1935 for the Santa Clara County Fire Department; a September 1935 newspaper item describes construction starting
Register: removed some time between 1986 and 1991. 1986 is the start of that window, not a dated record

State negative declaration (received March 1988) describes disassembling the tower and re-erecting it in San Benito County; an August 1988 notice describes relocating the tower and building a radio vault
State filing for a 120 ft self-supporting antenna tower at a Pacheco Peak communications facility

corrections.why: The register's Removed field reads late 1980s, and its description says the structure was removed some time between 1986 and 1991. No source gives 1980.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the lookout was constructed for the Santa Clara County Fire Department. The 1935 newspaper item names W.D. Winters as chief state fire ranger for Santa Clara County. The story reports both and does not choose.

The register gives a 30 enclosed timber tower with a cabin on top, without a unit, while the 1947 survey describes the whole house as about 40 feet high. The record's 12.2 m (40 ft) matches the survey. The story uses the survey's figure.

notes_for_editor: The 1988 negative declaration is garbled ('AT THE SAN BENITO COUNTY VENTION DISPLAY'). CEQAnet says the attachments are not online and must be requested from CAL FIRE, so the destination is not confirmed. The 1988 filings name Pacheco Peak and a lookout tower but not the register's cabin or tower directly; the link to the register's record rests on the same summit and the same era, and a reviewer could confirm it with CAL FIRE. The register's removal window (1986 to 1991) fits the 1988 filing. The brief's 1980 removal year has no source and is proposed for correction. Staffing, public access and current site condition were not found in any source read. Photos: none new; the register's 1977 and 2013 photos are already in the record. Searches: one WebSearch on the history and removal of the lookout, one on the 1988 and 1994 CEQAnet records.
